questions.question: How do we start?
questions.answer:
Contact us [here](/contact), we will first set up a phone call to determine if we are a good fit for your family. Next, we will schedule an intake session or in-school observation.

After services have begun, goals are created after 1 month of consistent attendance. Goals are not created after first visit as children will show you their difficulties after about a month or so. A goals meeting will be scheduled to discuss intervention strategies for both the interventionist and for the family to continue out-of-office hours. Goals are revisited and modified every 6 months.

questions.question: Do you take insurance or Regional Center Funding?
questions.answer: We are currently accepting only private pay and work with the Self-Determination program through the regional centers.

questions.question: What is the age range of kids you see?
questions.answer: We have children starting at 2 years old through 25 years of age in our current caseloads.

questions.question: Do you see kids without a diagnosis?
questions.answer: Yes, we have a blend of kids with and without diagnoses that come for services. If your child has a diagnosis, please bring any supporting documents for us to review during the intake session. This will speed up progress in meeting the goals we create together.
